cell_line.evidence: HeLa cells were cultured in DMEM for SILAC (Thermo Scientific) containing either “light” isotope amino acids, L-arginine monohydrochloride and L-lysine hydrate, or “heavy” isotope amino acids, 15N213C6-lysine (Lys8) and 15N413C6-arginine (Arg10), for 6 doublings time to let the cells reach complete incorporation.
